turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Welcome back, Dev. How are you holding up today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Wren. Honestly, I'm doing really well today. Just catching my breath after a pretty busy morning.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That sounds like a welcome change of pace. Did something happen with your applications?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, actually! I had my technical screen over at Ottergrove this morning, and it went really well. They gave me this problem, and I ended up explaining a window function step by step, just laying out each part of the logic without rushing.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That is wonderful to hear. How did it feel while you were walking through it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It felt surprisingly natural, almost like breaking down a concept for my old students. Afterward, I just felt so upbeat and a whole lot more confident about where I stand.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: You trusted your instincts. Did they give you any sense of what comes next?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She said the recruiting team should reach out early next week about the next round. She seemed pretty engaged while we chatted.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That sounds promising. What do you think made the explanation click so cleanly this time?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think just slowing down and not trying to sound overly fancy. I just spoke like a colleague explaining the data flow.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That grounded approach suits you. Are you planning to rest a bit today, or keep studying?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think I'm going to take a long walk outside and make a nice cup of coffee. I might glance at some notes tonight, but nothing heavy.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: A break sounds well earned. Would you like to check in again before next week starts?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, that'd be great. Let's do a quick check-in on Sunday evening.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Sunday evening works well. Ready to go grab that coffee?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely ready. Talk to you on Sunday, Wren!
